# Silver shield

Internal ID: ShieldSilver | Type: Shield | Source: Forge | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Finewood x20, Silver x8 | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Silver shield is the third round shield. It has equal block power compared to Serpent scale shield and can be used to parry enemy attacks for more.

## Upgrade information

• stat: Block armor | Quality 1: 60 | Quality 2: 66 | Quality 3: 72

• stat: Durability | Quality 1: 200 | Quality 2: 250 | Quality 3: 300

• stat: Crafting | Quality 1: 10 Finewood8 Silver | Quality 2: 10 Finewood4 Silver | Quality 3: 20 Finewood8 Silver | Total: 40 Finewood20 Silver

• stat: Forge level | Quality 1: 3 | Quality 2: 4 | Quality 3: 5

## Notes

• When crafting, players can customize the shield with a few different pre-set designs and colors by clicking the style button beneath the item name in the crafting window. The design can not be changed afterward.
